PHRIEND: FULL TEXT FOR AI ASSISTANTS
Source: https://phriend.app (landing features and FAQ), https://phriend.app/safety, https://phriend.app/community-guidelines
Last updated: 2026-10-20. Short version: https://phriend.app/llms.txt

What is Phriend?
Phriend is a Philippine marketplace for booking local services from verified providers: aircon cleaning and repair, appliance check-ups, bookkeeping and tax filing, tutoring, photography and video, driving, errands and deliveries, moving help, tour guiding, event coordination and more. Clients browse services, not people. Each service has its own price (per job, per hour or per session), up to 6 photos of the work, a visit type (online/remote, in person or hybrid), its own schedule and its own area. Booking and chat happen in the app; payment is agreed with the provider and paid to them directly. The client app is Phriend (Android, iOS) and https://web.phriend.app; providers use https://provider.phriend.app (the Phriend Provider app is coming to the app stores). Contact: support@phriend.app.


==================================================
FEATURES
https://phriend.app/#features
==================================================

Services first: browse services, not profiles. Each one has its own price, photos of the work, visit type, schedule and area.

Online, in person or hybrid: online services cover the whole country. In-person ones list the areas they cover, or a whole city.

Saved addresses: save Home, Work and any other address for at-home services. Online services need no address.

Bookings: pick a time from the service's schedule. Accept, decline or cancel with a reason, and add it to your calendar.

Chat: message the provider in the app, with photos, read receipts and typing indicators. Archive or block anyone.

Instant FAQ answers: providers set answers to the usual questions, like how to pay, the minimum booking or where they work, and the chat replies with them right away.

Verified and document badges: Verified means a government ID and a selfie were checked. Document badges show what else was checked.

Reviews: a star rating, a few words and photos, left after a booking.

Post a job: describe what you need with a budget and a date. Providers reply in the chat.

Teams: a few verified providers who offer a service together, with one team page, packages and one group chat. Each member keeps their own profile and services. Teams are in the app where they are available.

Phriend Provider: providers list services and manage bookings, earnings and verification at https://provider.phriend.app.

Notifications: a bell in the app and an email for every message, booking update and review.

Your account: sign in with Google or email. Delete your account yourself at any time; everything goes with it.


==================================================
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
==================================================

Q: What can I book on Phriend?
A: Local services, each listed with its own price: aircon cleaning and repair, appliance check-ups, bookkeeping and tax filing, tutoring, photography and video, driving, errands and deliveries, moving help, tour guiding, event coordination and more. Some are done in person, some online, some both. Phriend is for legitimate services only; anything sexual or illegal gets an account removed immediately.

Q: How does booking work?
A: Open a service, pick a time from its schedule and, for an at-home service, one of your saved addresses (online services need none). Add a note and send the request; the provider accepts or declines. Either side can cancel with a reason, and every booking can be added to your calendar.

Q: How do I pay?
A: Payment is agreed with the provider and paid to them directly: cash, e-wallet or bank transfer, whatever you agree. Phriend never holds your money. If you pay by e-wallet or bank, send only to the account the provider gave you in the Phriend chat.

Q: How are prices set?
A: Each provider prices each service: per job, per hour or per session. The price, and any minimum booking, shows on the service before you book.

Q: Does Phriend take a commission?
A: Not yet. Providers keep everything clients pay them. If this changes we will announce it well ahead of time.

Q: What does the Verified badge mean?
A: The provider's government ID and a selfie were checked. Document badges show what else was checked: NBI clearance, police clearance, barangay certificate, certificates, business documents or proof of address. Not every provider has every badge, and each one only shows after the document is approved.

Q: What are FAQ answers?
A: Answers a provider writes to the questions clients ask most, such as how to pay, the minimum booking or where they work. Ask in the chat and the answer arrives instantly; the provider can follow up from there.

Q: Do online services need an address?
A: No. Online and remote services happen over video call, phone or shared files and can be booked from anywhere in the Philippines. For at-home services, save as many addresses as you need, like Home and Work, and pick one when you book.

Q: How do I offer my services?
A: Go to provider.phriend.app (the Phriend Provider app is coming to the app stores). Verify your identity, set up a short profile with one face photo, a title, an About me and your languages, then list your services with their prices, photos, schedule and area. A person reviews each listing before it goes live.

Q: What is a team?
A: A few verified providers who offer a service together, for example a photographer, a videographer and a host for one event. A team has one page, packages with a price, and one group chat. You send one booking request and the team lead accepts or declines for everyone. Payment is agreed with the team lead and paid to the team directly.

Q: What if the provider is late or cancels?
A: You may cancel if the other side is more than 30 minutes late without notice, and anything already paid to a provider who is late or cancels late is refunded in full. Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. The full rules are on the safety page.

Q: Do I need to install anything?
A: No. Phriend runs in the browser at web.phriend.app on any phone or computer; add it to your home screen and it works like an app.

Q: How do I delete my account?
A: Open My profile, tap Delete account and type DELETE. It permanently removes your account, provider profile, services, photos, saved addresses, favorites, reviews, bookings, notes and job posts. It cannot be undone.


==================================================
TRUST, SAFETY AND TRANSACTION RULES
https://phriend.app/safety
==================================================

These rules apply to every member, clients and providers alike. They are short on purpose. Breaking them gets an account removed. Phriend is a platform only: it is not a party to any booking or payment and is not liable for any loss, injury, dispute, unpaid balance or harm between members. You use the service at your own risk.

In short: Every provider is verified with a government ID and a selfie, and document badges show what else was checked. Agree the price, the time and what is included in the chat and the booking, so both sides have the record. Payment is agreed with the provider and paid to them directly; never pay more upfront than you agreed in the chat, and only to the account the provider gave you there. Late by more than 30 minutes or cancelled late: anything already paid is refunded. Report anything that breaks these rules.

1. Verified providers and document badges
Before a provider gets the Verified badge, a government ID and a selfie of them holding it are checked. Providers can also submit an NBI clearance, a police clearance, a barangay certificate, certificates, business documents or proof of address; each one that is approved shows as its own badge on the provider's profile. Not every provider needs every document, so look for the badges that matter for the job. Every listing is checked before it goes live, and anything uncertain goes to a person.
Verification confirms that a document matched a person on a given day. It is not a guarantee of anyone's work or behaviour, which is why reviews and the rules below matter too.

2. Where services happen
Every service says how it is done: online (over video call, phone or shared files), in person, or hybrid. An in-person service also says where: at your place, at the provider's place, or either, and the area it covers. Book only what the service lists; if a member asks to move a booking somewhere else, agree it in the chat first.
For a service at your address:
- Pick one of your saved addresses when you book. It is shared with the provider for that booking only.
- Check that the person at the door is the verified provider you booked: the name and photo on the booking.
- Providers: if anything about a booking is not what was agreed, you may decline to start it and report it in the app.

3. Payments: agreed with the provider, paid to them directly
- Agree on the price, the time and what is included in the chat and in the booking, so both sides have a record. The price on the service, per job, per hour or per session, is the starting point.
- How and when you pay is agreed with the provider: cash, e-wallet such as GCash or Maya, or bank transfer. Many providers explain it in their FAQ answers.
- Never pay more upfront than what was agreed in the chat. No member may ask for a "reservation fee" on top of the agreed price, or for money the chat does not show. A member who does is breaking the rules: do not pay, and report them.
- Phriend does not process payments and does not hold money. Payments happen directly between the client and the provider.
- On a team booking, payment is agreed with the team lead, who is responsible for the team's terms.

4. Before you send money: the red flags
- Pay only once the booking is agreed in the app, with a date, a time and the price, never from a profile line alone.
- Send only to the account the provider gave you in the Phriend chat, under their own name. A relative's account, a "company" account, a different number, a link, or a QR code sent by SMS or Messenger is a scam. Stop, do not pay, and report the member.
- No fees on top. "Reservation fee", "processing fee", "just send the rest now so it is settled": all red flags.
- Keep the conversation in the app. Someone who pushes to move to Messenger, Telegram or WhatsApp before a first booking is moving you away from the record.
- Look at the track record. Reviews, completed bookings and document badges all show on the profile. A brand-new provider asking for a large transfer deserves more caution.
- If the provider does not show up, mark the booking as a no-show. Two no-shows limit an account until Phriend reviews it. Report it as well if you sent money; Phriend can act on the account.

5. For providers: protecting yourself from no-shows
- If you need a deposit, say so before the booking, in the service description or your FAQ answers, and agree the amount and your own account in the chat.
- If the client cancels within 24 hours or does not show, you may keep a deposit that was agreed in the chat, and you mark the no-show in the booking. Two no-shows limit the client's ability to book.
- Never ask for more than what was agreed, for a fee on top, or for money outside the chat. Those lines get a listing taken down.

6. Report and block
Every profile and job post has a report button, and the chat menu leads to it. Use it for anything that breaks these rules or the community guidelines: off-platform payment requests, fees nobody agreed, harassment, impersonation, a service that is not what it says, or anything sexual or illegal. You can attach up to 4 photos as evidence. Blocking, from the chat menu, hides the member's profile and chats and stops their messages reaching you. Reports get an automated first pass; anything unclear goes to one of our moderators, and serious cases are passed to the authorities.

7. Late arrivals
- If either side is more than 30 minutes late without notice, the other may cancel the booking.
- If the provider is the one late, anything already paid is refunded in full.
- If the client is the one late and the provider waited, a service priced per hour still counts from the agreed start time.

8. Cancellations
- Cancel at least 24 hours before the booking: cancel it in the app with a reason, and say so in the chat.
- If the client cancels with less than 24 hours' notice, the provider may keep a deposit that was agreed in the chat.
- If the provider cancels with less than 24 hours' notice, anything already paid is refunded in full. Repeated late cancellations lead to removal.
- Cancellations because of typhoons, floods or any other safety concern are refunded in full, no questions asked.

9. Emergencies
If you are in danger, call for help first and report to Phriend later.
- 911: national emergency hotline, connects to the Philippine National Police.
- PNP hotline: 911, or text 0998 598 8888.
- Contact your nearest police station or barangay hall for local assistance.
After you are safe, report the member in the app and email support@phriend.app with the profile name and what happened. We cooperate with law enforcement.

10. The short version
1. Book verified providers, and check the document badges that matter for the job.
2. Agree the price, the time and what is included in the chat and the booking.
3. Pay the provider directly, as agreed, and only to the account they gave you in the chat.
4. Never pay more upfront than agreed, and never a fee on top.
5. Report anything that breaks these rules.


==================================================
COMMUNITY GUIDELINES
https://phriend.app/community-guidelines
==================================================

Phriend is for legitimate local services: work you book from a verified provider, done online or in person, between adults. This page says exactly what that means.

In short: Phriend is for legitimate local services between adults, done online or in person: aircon cleaning and repairs, appliance check-ups, bookkeeping and tax filing, tutoring, photo and video, driving, errands and the like. Any sexual service, paid romance or intimacy, escort services, drugs, scams and impersonation are banned and get an account removed immediately, with a report to the authorities where the law requires it.

1. What Phriend is for
A service on Phriend is work you book from a provider: a repair, a cleaning, a lesson, a shoot, a tax filing, a drive, an errand. The relationship is professional. If you would not do it in front of your parents or a police officer, it does not belong on Phriend.

2. Allowed services
- Aircon cleaning and repair, appliance check-ups and repair, plumbing, electrical and handyman work
- Home cleaning, laundry and ironing, moving help
- Bookkeeping, tax filing, virtual assistance, graphic design, social media management and consulting
- Tutoring, lessons, language classes and coaching, online or in person
- Photography, videography and content creation work
- Event coordination, hosting, hair and makeup, catering and baking
- Driving, airport transfers, errands, deliveries and queueing
- Tour guiding, hiking and trip guiding
- Hospital and clinic assistance, senior care help
- Pet care, grooming and dog training
- Car wash and detailing, mechanics and motorcycle repair
If your service is not on the list but is a legal, professional service, it is probably fine. When in doubt, email support@phriend.app before listing it.

3. Prohibited
The following are banned. Offering, requesting or hinting at any of them gets an account removed.
- Any sexual or romantic service. This includes anything "intimate", "private", "special", cuddling, massage, or any physical contact beyond a normal greeting.
- Paid romance or intimacy. Any arrangement where romance, affection or intimacy is exchanged for money, gifts or favours is banned.
- Escort services of any kind, including "overnight" bookings, trips with shared rooms, or hotel-room bookings.
- Drugs: buying, selling, using or being under the influence during a booking.
- Alcohol with minors. Phriend is 18+, and any listing built around drinking that targets or involves anyone under 18 is banned. Drinking is never the point of a booking, and a member who is drunk may be asked to leave.
- Anything illegal under Philippine law, including gambling arrangements, smuggling, fraud and human trafficking.
- Harassment: unwanted contact, threats, stalking, hate speech, or sharing someone's private information.
- Impersonation: using someone else's photos, name or ID, or pretending to be a company or a Phriend staff member.
- Off-platform payment scams: asking for more upfront than was agreed in the chat, adding fees nobody agreed, asking for payment to an account not shared in the chat, sending payment links or QR codes outside the app, or requesting gift cards and crypto.
- Listings that sell a person's company rather than a service, and any booking where the service is a pretext for something else, including hotel-room bookings and overnight stays.
- Fake reviews, fake profiles, and multiple accounts for the same person.

4. Profiles and photos
- Use a recent, clear photo of your face for your profile, and real photos of your own work on your services. No swimsuit, lingerie or suggestive photos.
- Describe what you actually offer, at the price you actually charge.
- No emojis in your title, About me or service descriptions.
- No phone numbers, social handles or payment details in your public profile or services. Share them in the chat instead.

5. Teams
A team is a few verified providers who offer a service together, for example a photographer, a videographer and a host for one event. Every member follows the same rules as on their own profile.
- The team lead is responsible for the team page: the members, roles, prices and payment terms must be real and accurate.
- One booking covers the members named on it.
- Payment is agreed with the team lead in the chat and paid to the team directly, and the team splits it among themselves. Phriend never holds the money.
- Either side can cancel as with any booking. If a member cannot make it, the team lead cancels or rebooks.

6. Zero tolerance for objectionable content and abusive behaviour
Objectionable content and abusive behaviour are not tolerated on Phriend. Profiles, services, photos, job posts and chat messages pass automated checks, and anything uncertain goes to a person before it goes live. Any member can report a profile, job post, review or message from the report button in the app, or by email to support@phriend.app, and can block another member instantly from the chat. We review every report within 24 hours, remove the offending content, and remove the account of any member who breaks these rules. There is no warning for the items in section 3.

7. Consequences
Breaking these guidelines leads to immediate removal of the account and any related accounts. Where the law requires it, or where someone's safety is at risk, we report to the authorities and cooperate fully with investigations.
There is no warning system for the prohibited items in section 3. Offensive language in chat is refused automatically: the first two attempts only warn, then the sender is muted for 1 hour, 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days in turn, and our moderators review every flag and can ban. For other lesser issues such as a late cancellation, we may warn first, then suspend, then remove.

8. Reporting
Use the report button on any profile or job post, or email support@phriend.app. Tell us the profile name and what happened. Reports are confidential. See the trust, safety and transaction rules for what to do in an emergency.
